description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget class 'BoardTile', which represents a single, interactive, animated tile for a Tic Tac Toe game board. The widget shows X or O with visual effects, handles tap interactions with scale animations, and supports highlighting for game-winning conditions.

classes.name: BoardTile
classes.description: A square, animated tile widget for the Tic Tac Toe game board that displays either an X or O, with tap feedback and styling.

classes.name: _BoardTileState
classes.description: State class for BoardTile managing animation controllers and gestures for tap interactions.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the animation controller and scale animation for tap feedback.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the animation controller when the widget is removed.

methods.name: _handleTapDown
methods.description: Handles tap down event; triggers press animation if enabled.

methods.name: _handleTapCancel
methods.description: Handles tap cancellation, reversing the press animation.

methods.name: _handleTapUp
methods.description: Handles tap release, reversing the press animation.

methods.description: Builds the widget tree, including gesture detector, animated scale, decoration, and text display.
